en.topic_title: China abruptly delays unmanned moon mission over ‘launch conditions’
en.topic_summary:
China’s manned space agency said on Sunday it is delaying a research moon mission that is part of Beijing’s efforts to land a crew there by 2030, less than two weeks after a rare launch failure.



The Chang’e-7 lunar probe on a Long March 5 carrier rocket. Photo: CCTV screenshot.
